summary.text: Shelli Yoder is a Democrat who was elected to the Indiana Senate in 2020 and represents District 40, which includes most of Monroe County and the Indiana University-Bloomington campus.
She leads the Indiana Senate Democratic Caucus and is a senior lecturer at the Indiana University Kelley School of Business.

paragraphs.text: According to her Indiana Senate Democrats biography, Yoder holds a master's degree in counseling and human services from Indiana University South Bend and a master's in divinity from Vanderbilt.
She is a former Monroe County Council member.

She received the 2022 Friend of Public Education Award from the Indiana State Teachers Association, was a 2022 selected member for the Advancement of Bipartisanship of the State Legislative Leaders Foundation and was a 2021 Bowen Fellow of the Council of State Governments' Legislative Leadership Development program.
The page says she lives in Bloomington with her spouse and three children.
